messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed several rollout entries in the console showing "actor": "service:deploy-bot" and no human, which makes 'who changed what' exports unusable for auditors.
sam: Ugh. Yeah that happens when CI runs the rollout job, or when an engineer uses the infra API with a deploy token.
priya: Is the ask to surface the approving human in the UI/export, or to keep the raw actor but add an 'attributed_to' field?
maya: Prefer keep raw, but add attribution heuristics and show both in timeline + include in export. Auditors want trace back to a person when available.
andre: We have three possible heuristics I can think of:
  1) If rollout has an approval event, attribute to the approver.
  2) If commit/PR is linked, attribute to PR author.
  3) Fallback to service account.
priya: Those seem sensible. Need clear precedence and a flag to opt-out for teams with strict separation-of-duty.
sam: Implementation notes: event shape today is compact. Propose adding `attribution` object. Example:
```
{
  "actor": "service:deploy-bot",
  "attribution": {"source": "approval", "by": "maya", "id": "approval:987"}
}
```
maya: Looks good. For exports we should have two modes: full (contains attribution metadata) and redacted (PII removed). Compliance teams will choose.
andre: Also need to consider sampling for big tenants — we can't always export full payload for every change. Suggest sampling with deterministic hashing on tenant+change-id so audits are reproducible.
priya: Good call. Also add TTL and retention metadata so exports respect tenant retention policies.
audit-bot: Note added: ticket INF-3129 created for attribution heuristics + export modes.
sam: UX: console timeline should show primary actor line as human when attribution exists, but tooltip shows original actor + provenance. Quick mock: "maya via deploy-bot — approved 2024-04-01".
maya: Awesome. Can we also add a small badge if attribution is inferred vs explicit? (inferred = heuristics)
priya: Yes — explicit vs inferred badges, and a link to the chain (approval -> PR -> job).
andre: I'll scope work: backend event enrichment service + export schema v2 + console tweaks. Will draft API and wire up canary flag for a couple of tenants.
sam: Thanks. Can we add a small test plan: 1) approval attribution 2) PR attribution 3) fallback to service 4) export redaction modes 5) sampling determinism
maya: Added acceptance criteria in INF-3129. Please ping when PR is ready for review. :thumbsup:
